learning_items.description: Learn how you can set permissions to limit access to an environment, or limit which users can view, edit, or delete data in an environment within Dataverse.

learning_items.title: Use administration options for Dataverse
learning_items.description: Do you need to use administration options that are available for Dataverse? This module will show you how you can use solutions within Dataverse and administer environments.

programs.title: Use export control in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
programs.description: Ensure compliance with international regulations by defining and validating export rules using an advanced export control system.

learning_items.title: Work with export control in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
learning_items.description: Learn how to work with export control.

learning_items.title: Extend export control in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
learning_items.description: You can use the **Extend export** control in Supply Chain Management if you want to extend various functionalities for implementing export controls.

programs.title: Manage your education devices with Microsoft 365
programs.description: This learning path introduces you to the features and capabilities of device management using Microsoft 365.

learning_items.title: Manage devices used for education
learning_items.description: This module will introduce some of the tools you can leverage to deploy and manage devices used for education.

learning_items.title: Deploy and enroll your education devices
learning_items.description: This module will introduce you to the different options you can use to provision new and existing devices for the start of the school year. You'll learn how to set up school PCs and Windows Autopilot for Windows devices and about automated device enrollment for iOS devices.

learning_items.title: Deploy applications using Microsoft Intune and Intune for Education
learning_items.description: This module introduces you to the Microsoft Store for Education from which you can deploy both free and paid-for apps. These apps can be either Windows or iOS apps. Learn how to configure Microsoft Entra requirements needed in this environment.

learning_items.title: Manage scoped administration and delegation with Microsoft Intune and Intune for Education
learning_items.description: Discover how to manage scoped administration and delegation with Microsoft Intune and Intune for Education.

programs.title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot in .NET
programs.description: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending Copilot for Microsoft 365 in .NET. This series helps you understand what Copilot for Microsoft 365 is and how it works. It also explains why you should consider extending it to give it access to data in your organization and what options you have to extend it.

learning_items.title: Get started with Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
learning_items.description: Learn what Microsoft 365 Copilot is and why you should consider extending it. Learn about the different options that you have for extending Microsoft 365 Copilot.

learning_items.title: Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to your external data in real-time with message extension plugins built with .NET and Visual Studio
learning_items.description: Learn how to build Microsoft 365 Copilot message extension plugins to connect it to external data sources and extend its capabilities.

learning_items.title: Integrate external content with Microsoft 365 Copilot using Copilot connectors built with .NET
learning_items.description: Build Copilot connectors to import external content to Microsoft 365. You can build Copilot connectors on any platform and using any programming language.

programs.title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot in TypeScript
programs.description: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending Copilot for Microsoft 365 in TypeScript. This series helps you understand what Copilot for Microsoft 365 is and how it works. It also explains why you should consider extending it to give it access to data in your organization and what options you have to extend it.

learning_items.title: Get started with Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
learning_items.description: Learn what Microsoft 365 Copilot is and why you should consider extending it. Learn about the different options that you have for extending Microsoft 365 Copilot.

learning_items.title: Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to your external data in real-time with message extension plugins built with TypeScript and Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Learn how to build Microsoft 365 Copilot message extension plugins to connect it to external data sources and extend its capabilities with TypeScript.

learning_items.title: Integrate external content with Microsoft 365 Copilot using Copilot connectors built with TypeScript
learning_items.description: Build Copilot connectors using TypeScript to import external content to Microsoft 365.

programs.title: Extend declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot with API plugins using Visual Studio Code
programs.description: Extend declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot with API plugins is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending declarative agents with actions using API plugins. You learn what API plugins are, how they work, and when you should consider building them. You also learn how to use Adaptive Cards to show data in a rich way and how to connect to secured APIs.

learning_items.title: Introduction to actions with API plugins for declarative agents
learning_items.description: Determine the scenarios for which actions for declarative agents with API plugins are suitable. Describe the function of API plugins.

learning_items.title: Build your first action for declarative agents with API plugin by using Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Build a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot optimized for a specific scenario. Bring actions to your agent with API plugins to access external data in real-time.

learning_items.title: Use Adaptive Cards to show data in API plugins for declarative agents
learning_items.description: Learn how to enhance the user experience of declarative agents by using Adaptive Cards to render API data visually. Create and configure Adaptive Card templates, integrate them into API plugins, and test the setup in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Learn the practical steps for building and previewing Adaptive Cards in Visual Studio Code.

learning_items.title: Authenticate your API plugin for declarative agents with secured APIs
learning_items.description: When building apps for work, you typically integrate with secured APIs. Learn about the two common ways of how APIs are secured – API key and OAuth2, and how to integrate with them when building an API plugin for declarative agents that run in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

programs.title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with declarative agents using Visual Studio Code
programs.description: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with declarative agents is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of extending Microsoft 365 Copilot using Visual Studio Code. You learn what declarative agents are, how they work, and when you should consider building them. You also learn, how to extend them with skills and knowledge to make them more powerful and useful.

learning_items.title: Introduction to declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot
learning_items.description: Learn how to use declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot to automate tasks and workflows.

learning_items.title: Build your first declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot by using Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Implement a declarative agent with custom knowledge.

learning_items.title: Challenge project - Build a declarative agent to chat with your docs
learning_items.description: Demonstrate your ability to create a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot that can answer questions using information from documents.

learning_items.title: Build your first action for declarative agents with API plugin by using Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Build a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot optimized for a specific scenario. Bring actions to your agent with API plugins to access external data in real-time.

learning_items.title: Use Adaptive Cards to show data in API plugins for declarative agents
learning_items.description: Learn how to enhance the user experience of declarative agents by using Adaptive Cards to render API data visually. Create and configure Adaptive Card templates, integrate them into API plugins, and test the setup in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Learn the practical steps for building and previewing Adaptive Cards in Visual Studio Code.

learning_items.title: Challenge project - Build a declarative agent to chat with your data
learning_items.description: Demonstrate your ability to create a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot that access data from an external API.

learning_items.title: Add custom knowledge to declarative agents using Copilot connectors and Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Build a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot optimized for a specific scenario. Your agent accesses data stored outside of Microsoft 365 by using a Copilot connector.

learning_items.title: Challenge project - Build a declarative agent to chat with your external data ingested to Microsoft 365
learning_items.description: Demonstrate your ability to create a declarative agent that can chat with your external data ingested to Microsoft 365.

programs.title: Learn how Microsoft supports data discovery, classification, and protection as part of a cybersecurity solution
programs.description: Know your data, protect your data, and don't lose your data. These are the basic tenets of good information protection - data discovery, classification, and protection. This learning path provides an overview of the Microsoft data protection capabilities and how to use them to protect and govern data as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for the heads of federal civilian agencies to evaluate and classify agency data and provide to DHS and OMB a report of their evaluation, per Section 8 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **August 24, 2021**.

learning_items.title: Introduction to information security and compliance in Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Discover the tools and concepts in Microsoft Purview for managing and protecting sensitive data. Understand how to keep data secure and compliant throughout its lifecycle across different environments.

learning_items.title: Prevent data loss with Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) helps safeguard sensitive information by monitoring and preventing accidental data leaks across your organization's digital platforms. In this module, you'll learn how to plan, deploy, and adjust DLP policies to protect sensitive data in your organization, ensuring security without disrupting daily work.

programs.title: Learn how Microsoft supports using multifactor authentication as part of a cybersecurity solution
programs.description: Multifactor authentication helps secure your environment and resources by requiring that your users confirm their identity by using multiple authentication methods, like a phone call, text message, mobile app notification, or one-time password. You can use multifactor authentication both on-premises and in the cloud to add security for accessing Microsoft online services, remote access applications, and more. This learning path provides an overview of how to use multifactor authentication as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for agencies to adopt multifactor authentication and encryption at rest and in transit to the maximum extent (and report on progress every 60 days), per Section 3 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **November 8, 2021**.

learning_items.title: Secure Microsoft Entra users with multifactor authentication
learning_items.description: Learn how to use multifactor authentication with Microsoft Entra ID to harden your user accounts.

learning_items.title: Understand Microsoft 365 identity and access management
learning_items.description: Learn how Microsoft 365 implements the principle of Zero Standing Access (ZSA) to protect production environments and customer data using Just-In-Time (JIT) and Just-Enough-Access (JEA).

learning_items.title: Implement and manage hybrid identity
learning_items.description: Creating a hybrid-identity solution to use your on-premises active directory can be challenging. Explore how to implement a secure hybrid-identity solution.

programs.title: Learn how Microsoft supports secure software development as part of a cybersecurity solution
programs.description: Secure software development means integrating security into each phase of your development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to maintenance. Microsoft provides many services that can help you develop more secure code and deploy a more secure application in the cloud. This learning path provides an overview of the services and offerings available to help you build secure software as part of a cybersecurity solution.The deadline for agencies to comply with NIST/CISA/OMB guidance on security measures for critical software (including applying practices of least privilege, network segmentation, and proper configuration), per section 4 of the Executive Order on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity, is **August 10, 2021**. The deadline for agencies to comply with the guidance identifying practices that enhance the security of the software supply chain with respect to software procurement, also per section 4, is **March 8, 2022**.

learning_items.title: Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework - Security
learning_items.description: Discover the tools that Azure provides to help you design a secure environment throughout your infrastructure, data, network, and applications.

learning_items.title: Introduction to GitHub
learning_items.description: Learn to use key GitHub features, including issues, notifications, branches, commits, and pull requests.

learning_items.title: Maintain a secure repository by using GitHub best practices
learning_items.description: Learn best practices for building, hosting, and maintaining a secure repository on GitHub.

programs.title: Extend Microsoft Viva Connections
programs.description: Extend Microsoft Viva Connections is a multi-part series that teaches you how to extend Microsoft Viva Connections with custom components. These modules will guide you through the basics of Microsoft Viva Connections extensibility through hands-on exercises, which cover the different types of extensions that you can build for Viva Connections.

learning_items.title: Get started with Microsoft Viva Connections
learning_items.description: Learn what Microsoft Viva Connections is, how your organization will benefit from using it, and how to enable it in your Microsoft 365 tenant.

learning_items.title: Extend Microsoft Viva Connections with web parts
learning_items.description: Learn how to extend Viva Connections with custom web parts by using your existing web development skills. You'll learn about the scenarios where web parts are most suitable and how to build them.

learning_items.title: Extend Microsoft Viva Connections with application customizers
learning_items.description: Learn how to extend Viva Connections with custom application customizers by using your existing web development skills. You'll learn about the scenarios where they're most suitable and how to build them.

learning_items.title: Extend Microsoft Viva Connections with Adaptive Card Extensions
learning_items.description: Learn how to extend Viva Connections with custom Adaptive Card Extensions using nothing but your existing web development skills. You'll learn about the scenarios where they're most suitable and how to build them.

learning_items.title: Create Adaptive Card Extensions (ACE) for Microsoft Viva Connections
learning_items.description: This module will teach you how to create custom Adaptive Card Extensions (ACEs) with the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) for Viva Connections dashboards. These ACEs will work in all Viva Connections clients, including desktop and mobile apps.

programs.title: Microsoft Graph Fundamentals
programs.description: New to Microsoft Graph? Microsoft Graph Fundamentals is a multi-part series that teaches you basic concepts of Microsoft Graph. It will guide you with hands-on exercises on how to use Microsoft Graph API requests to start developing or enhancing your applications with Microsoft 365 data.

learning_items.title: What is Microsoft Graph?
learning_items.description: Microsoft Graph provides access to data stored across Microsoft 365 services. Custom applications can use the Microsoft Graph API to connect to data and use it in custom applications to enhance organizational productivity.

learning_items.title: Configure a JavaScript application to retrieve Microsoft 365 data by using Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to create a custom JavaScript application to retrieve Microsoft 365 data by using Microsoft Graph.

learning_items.title: Access user photo information by using Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to create a custom JavaScript application to retrieve user photo information by using Microsoft Graph.

programs.title: Explore Microsoft Graph scenarios for JavaScript development
programs.description: This learning path includes hands-on exercises that will show you how to perform common tasks, such as showing a user's emails, accessing calendar events, and downloading and uploading files, in a JavaScript app using Microsoft Graph APIs.

learning_items.title: Show a user's emails in a JavaScript app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to show a user's emails in JavaScript apps with Microsoft Graph. Also, learn how to optimize Microsoft Graph queries and page through large datasets.

learning_items.title: Access a user's calendar events in a JavaScript app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Microsoft Graph provides access to data stored across Microsoft 365 services. In this module, you'll learn how to access Microsoft 365 data to show a user's default calendar in a JavaScript application by using Microsoft Graph APIs and SDKs. To make sure that the web app only shows what's immediately relevant to the user, you'll access and display occurrences and instances of events for a given period.

learning_items.title: Download and upload files in a JavaScript app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to list, download, and upload a user's files from a single-page application by using Microsoft Graph.

programs.title: Develop apps with the Microsoft Graph Toolkit
programs.description: New to Microsoft Graph Toolkit? Develop Apps with Microsoft Graph Toolkit helps you learn basic concepts of Microsoft Graph Toolkit. It will guide you with hands-on exercises on how to use the Microsoft Graph Toolkit, a set of web components and authentication providers to connect your web app to Microsoft Graph and load data from Microsoft 365.

learning_items.title: Get started with Microsoft Graph Toolkit
learning_items.description: Learn how to use Microsoft Graph Toolkit, a set of web components and authentication providers to connect your web app to Microsoft Graph and load data from Microsoft 365. You can use Microsoft Graph Toolkit in any JavaScript framework.

learning_items.title: Configure and style Microsoft Graph Toolkit components by using attributes and CSS
learning_items.description: Microsoft Graph Toolkit components are flexible for customization. You can change the behavior of components by using attributes. You can also customize component styling by using CSS custom properties to match your app's branding.

learning_items.title: Customize the presentation of Microsoft Graph Toolkit components by using templates
learning_items.description: Microsoft Graph Toolkit components are flexible for customization. You can change the presentation of Microsoft Graph Toolkit components by using templates and learn troubleshooting techniques for rendering.

learning_items.title: Improve your app's performance when using Microsoft Graph Toolkit
learning_items.description: Learn about caching features offered with Microsoft Graph Toolkit, and discover how to quickly display any more data you might need in Microsoft Graph Toolkit components.

programs.title: Defend against threats with Microsoft 365
programs.description: Microsoft 365 includes security technologies that enterprises can use to secure email, data, devices, and identities against the risk of cyber threats. This learning path provides an introduction to Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

learning_items.title: Protect against threats with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
learning_items.description: Learn how Microsoft Defender for Endpoint can help your organization stay secure.

learning_items.title: Remediate threats using Microsoft Defender
learning_items.description: Learn how to investigate and remediate threats using Microsoft Defender for Office 365. Explore automated tools, phishing triage, and attack simulation.

learning_items.title: Safeguard your environment with Microsoft Defender for Identity
learning_items.description: Learn about the Microsoft Defender for Identity component of Microsoft Defender XDR.

programs.title: Build and deploy apps for Microsoft Teams using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
programs.description: Teams Toolkit is an extension for Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio 2022. It helps developers create and deploy Teams apps with integrated identity, cloud storage and other services across Microsoft 365 and Azure. In this Learn path, you'll learn how to build a Microsoft Teams app using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code.

learning_items.title: Get started building apps for Microsoft Teams by using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Learn how to use the Teams Toolkit extension for Visual Studio Code to build Teams apps.

learning_items.title: Build a bot by using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: A bot, commonly called a chat bot, uses a conversational interface that users can interact with by sending and receiving messages that contain text or interactive cards. Bots are highly flexible and can be used in many ways, such as sending messages proactively, carrying out actions when instructed to, and performing multiple-step workflows. Bots can also be used in many Microsoft Teams contexts, as a personal bot, in a one-to-one or group chat, in Teams channel conversations, or in Teams meeting chats.

learning_items.title: Build a Microsoft Teams tab app by using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: In this module, you'll learn how to build a Microsoft Teams tab by using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code.

learning_items.title: Add chat to a Microsoft Teams app by using the Teams JavaScript client library
learning_items.description: The Microsoft Teams JavaScript client library can help you integrate native Teams features right in your application. In this module, you'll learn how to integrate the Teams chat capability in your app by using the Teams JavaScript client library.

learning_items.title: Deploy a Microsoft Teams app to Azure by using Teams Toolkit for Visual Studio Code
learning_items.description: Learn about infrastructure requirements and how to get set up to host and publish your app in Microsoft Teams by using the Teams Toolkit extension.

programs.title: Explore Microsoft Graph scenarios for ASP.NET Core development
programs.description: This learning path includes hands-on exercises that will show you how to perform common tasks, such as showing a user's emails, accessing calendar events, and downloading and uploading files, in an ASP.NET Core app using Microsoft Graph APIs.

learning_items.title: Show a user's emails in an ASP.NET Core app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to show a user's emails in ASP.NET Core apps with Microsoft Graph. Also, learn how to optimize Microsoft Graph queries and load email in batches.

learning_items.title: Access a user's calendar events in an ASP.NET Core app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Microsoft Graph provides access to data stored across Microsoft 365 services. In this module, you'll learn how to access Microsoft 365 data to show a user's default calendar in an ASP.NET Core application by using Microsoft Graph APIs and SDKs. To make sure that the web app only shows what's immediately relevant to the user, you'll access and display occurrences and instances of events for a given period.

learning_items.title: Download and upload files in an ASP.NET Core app with Microsoft Graph
learning_items.description: Learn how to list, download, and upload a user's files in an ASP.NET Core application by using Microsoft Graph.

programs.title: Establish the guiding principles and core components of Zero Trust
programs.description: Zero Trust is not a product or tool, but an essential security strategy that seeks to continuously verify every transaction, asserts least privilege access, and assumes that every transaction could be a possible attack.  Through the modules in this learning path, you'll gain an understanding of Zero Trust and how it applies to identity, endpoints, applications, networks, infrastructure, and data.

learning_items.title: Introduction to Zero Trust
learning_items.description: In recent years, the Zero Trust concept has emerged as a go-to security solution for organizations big or small. The Zero Trust approach is a combination of modern technologies and best practices that strengthens the security infrastructure within your organization.

learning_items.title: Describe identities in Zero Trust
learning_items.description: With the advent of cloud applications and the increase in employees working remotely, or bringing their own devices, it's critical to verify identities with strong authentication and ensure access is compliant.

learning_items.title: Secure endpoints with Zero Trust
learning_items.description: Learn how to use Zero Trust to secure endpoints to protect your organization and its users.

learning_items.title: Describe application access in Zero Trust
learning_items.description: Learn how to use Zero Trust to secure your applications and to protect your organization and its users.

learning_items.title: Manage networks with Zero Trust
learning_items.description: Networks enable us to communicate with everyone, from sharing pictures and video chats to online shopping and banking. Protecting your network from cybercriminals can be demanding as many of us move to hybrid working. A Zero Trust strategy will help to keep your networks safe and your data secure.

learning_items.title: Protect infrastructure with Zero Trust
learning_items.description: Infrastructure is a broad term that covers all hardware, software, servers, networks, facilities, and much more. Utilizing Zero Trust principles can help to reduce your infrastructure's exposure to cyberattacks through improved monitoring, configuration management, and keeping software up-to-date.

learning_items.title: Protect data with Zero Trust
learning_items.description: Zero Trust isn't a tool or product, it's an essential security strategy, with data at its core.  Here, you'll learn how to identify and protect your data using a Zero Trust approach.

programs.title: Implement information protection and data loss prevention by using Microsoft Purview
programs.description: Gain the skills to use Microsoft Purview to improve your data security in Microsoft 365. In this training, you learn how to create sensitive information types, create sensitivity labels, and use auto-labeling policies based on these labels. You also learn how to set up DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies to safeguard your organization's data. (SC-5003)

learning_items.title: Introduction to information security and compliance in Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Discover the tools and concepts in Microsoft Purview for managing and protecting sensitive data. Understand how to keep data secure and compliant throughout its lifecycle across different environments.

learning_items.title: Create and manage sensitive information types
learning_items.description: Create and manage sensitive information types.

learning_items.title: Create and configure sensitivity labels with Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels enable you to classify and protect sensitive data throughout your organization, including in the cloud and on devices. This module covers how to classify and protect sensitive information to ensure its security and compliance.

learning_items.title: Prevent data loss with Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) helps safeguard sensitive information by monitoring and preventing accidental data leaks across your organization's digital platforms. In this module, you'll learn how to plan, deploy, and adjust DLP policies to protect sensitive data in your organization, ensuring security without disrupting daily work.

learning_items.title: Implement information protection and data loss prevention with Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: This module guides you through implementing data security with Microsoft Purview to enhance data protection and comply with data loss prevention standards within your organization.

programs.title: Govern and protect sensitive information in the age of AI
programs.description: Develop skills in securing and governing data within AI-driven environments, using Microsoft Purview to navigate AI risks and ensure compliance. This path enhances your understanding of adapting security and governance strategies in response to the evolving landscape of AI technology.

learning_items.title: Manage AI data security challenges with Microsoft Purview
learning_items.description: Microsoft Purview helps you strengthen data security in AI environments, providing tools to handle challenges from AI technology. Learn to safeguard your data and adapt to evolving security challenges in AI technology.

learning_items.title: Manage compliance with Microsoft Purview for Microsoft 365 Copilot
learning_items.description: This module focuses on using Microsoft Purview for compliance management with Microsoft 365 Copilot. You'll learn how to handle compliance aspects of Copilot's AI functionalities through Purview.

learning_items.title: Identify and mitigate AI data security risks
learning_items.description: Identify and mitigate AI data security risks.

programs.title: Extend Microsoft SharePoint – Associate
programs.description: Microsoft SharePoint is a customizable platform that developers can extend with custom components. The SharePoint Framework is the recommended development model to extend the modern SharePoint experience. In this learning path, you'll learn how to customize and extend SharePoint using the SharePoint Framework using web parts and extensions.

learning_items.title: Configure a SharePoint Framework development environment
learning_items.description: Configure a SharePoint Framework development environment and build your first client-side web part for SharePoint Online.

learning_items.title: Develop web parts with the SharePoint Framework
learning_items.description: Learn how to create client-side web parts with the SharePoint Framework, test them in the SharePoint-hosted Workbench, and use the SharePoint Framework API.

learning_items.title: Enable SharePoint Framework web part configuration with property panes
learning_items.description: Learn how to enable web part configurations with property panes in the SharePoint Framework.

learning_items.title: Work with SharePoint Content using the SharePoint Framework
learning_items.description: Work with SharePoint content in SharePoint Framework projects using the SharePoint REST API, perform CRUD operations, and create mock data with the local workbench.

learning_items.title: Extend the SharePoint user interface with SharePoint Framework extensions
learning_items.description: Learn how to extend the SharePoint user interface with SharePoint Framework extensions.

learning_items.title: Create Adaptive Card Extensions (ACE) for Microsoft Viva Connections
learning_items.description: This module will teach you how to create custom Adaptive Card Extensions (ACEs) with the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) for Viva Connections dashboards. These ACEs will work in all Viva Connections clients, including desktop and mobile apps.

learning_items.title: Use Microsoft Graph and non-Microsoft APIs in SharePoint Framework solutions
learning_items.description: This module will teach you how to use external APIs in your SharePoint Framework projects. You'll learn how to use data from anonymous APIs, REST APIs secured with Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Graph.

learning_items.title: Deploy SharePoint Framework components to production
learning_items.description: Deploy SharePoint Framework solutions to tenant and site collection App Catalogs, manage component and package versions, and update components in production.

learning_items.title: Build Microsoft Teams customization using the SharePoint Framework
learning_items.description: Learn how to host SharePoint Framework web parts as tabs in Microsoft Teams, detect where a component is running, and configure its tab settings.

programs.title: Deliver remote desktops and apps with Azure Virtual Desktop
programs.description: Azure Virtual Desktop on Microsoft Azure is a desktop and app virtualization service that runs on the cloud. Azure Virtual Desktop works across devices – including Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android – with full-featured apps that you can use to access remote desktops and apps.

learning_items.title: Introduction to Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Learn how to use Azure Virtual Desktop to deliver remote desktop and remote app experiences in Microsoft Azure.

learning_items.title: Prepare for Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Learn how to prepare for Azure Virtual Desktop - a cloud-based virtualization solution running on Microsoft Azure. Azure Virtual Desktop is an elastically scalable service to deliver remote desktop and remote app experiences - without having to manage the underlying server infrastructure. Review the prerequisites and tools provided by Microsoft get ready to provision your first Azure Virtual Desktop host pool.

learning_items.title: Deploy Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Learn how to deploy Azure Virtual Desktop and customize the workspace for your users.

learning_items.title: Optimize Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Learn how to optimize deployment and infrastructure costs using Azure Virtual Desktops native scaling tool Autoscale. Learn how to configure Autoscale so that session host VMs are only running when you need them to be.

learning_items.title: Secure an Azure Virtual Desktop deployment
learning_items.description: Introduction to Microsoft security capabilities that can help keep your applications and data secure in your Azure Virtual Desktop deployment.

learning_items.title: Deploy applications by using MSIX app attach for Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Learn how to deliver applications by using MSIX app attach. MSIX app attach is an application delivery technology that separates applications and their state from the operating system and assigns applications to users dynamically.

learning_items.title: Protect your Azure Virtual Desktop deployment by using Azure Firewall
learning_items.description: Learn how to deploy and configure Azure Firewall to protect outbound network traffic for Azure Virtual Desktop.

learning_items.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery for Azure Virtual Desktop
learning_items.description: Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop is a cloud service that helps you give users a secure remote desktop that they can use anywhere. With Azure Virtual Desktop, you can plan appropriate business continuity and disaster recovery (BCDR) strategies to help protect against both unplanned and planned failures and to provide redundancy.

programs.title: Get started with Microsoft Viva Insights (Workplace Analytics)
programs.description: Collaboration is a key component of knowledge-worker success. Microsoft Viva Insights (Workplace Analytics) turns Microsoft 365 data into useful insights about how organizations get work done and empowers leaders to drive strategies for positive change. Get started with Microsoft Workplace Analytics introduces how you can use Workplace Analytics to access these insights. Learn what Workplace Analytics is and how it works, how to onboard to Workplace Analytics from the administrator perspective, how you can evaluate and track collaboration with the Ways of working assessment, and how you can use Workplace Analytics and MyAnalytics to drive organizational change.

learning_items.title: Discover Workplace Analytics with Microsoft Viva Insights
learning_items.description: Learn how to use Workplace Analytics with Viva Insights to generate analysis about how to improve collaboration in your organization

learning_items.title: Onboard to Microsoft Viva Insights (Workplace Analytics)
learning_items.description: Learn how to onboard to Microsoft Viva Insights (Workplace Analytics), from the administrator perspective.

learning_items.title: Analyze collaboration and engagement using the Ways of working assessment dashboard in Power BI
learning_items.description: Learn to evaluate collaboration culture and employee experience with a Power BI template by using Viva Insights data in Workplace Analytics.

learning_items.title: Drive organizational change with Microsoft Viva Insights (Workplace Analytics and MyAnalytics)
learning_items.description: After using Microsoft Viva Insights with Workplace Analytics and Power BI to generate insights about your employees’ work behaviors, you’ll learn about the Microsoft 365 features that can be tools to implement and measure the changes you’ve identified. You’ll learn how to initiate common change practices and what tools and tactics are the most useful.

programs.title: Develop data-driven applications by using Azure SQL Database
programs.description: Learn how to develop data-driven applications by using Microsoft Azure SQL Database. DP-3020

learning_items.title: Get started with Azure SQL Database for modern application development
learning_items.description: Learn how Azure SQL Database works, the key concepts, and practical examples to help developers effectively utilize Azure SQL Database in their cloud-based applications.

learning_items.title: Build your first microservice with .NET
learning_items.description: Microservice applications are composed of small, independently versioned, and scalable customer-focused services that communicate with each other by using standard protocols and well-defined interfaces. Each microservice typically encapsulates simple business logic, which you can scale out or in. You test, deploy, and manage the microservice independently. Smaller teams develop a microservice based on a customer scenario, and choose the technologies that they use. This module teaches you how to build your first microservice by using .NET.

learning_items.title: Deploy a .NET microservice to Kubernetes
learning_items.description: Microservice applications are composed of small, independently versioned, and scalable customer-focused services. Microservices applications deployed in containers make it possible to scale out apps, and respond to increased demand by deploying more container instances, and to scale back if demand is decreasing. In complex solutions of many microservices the process of deploying, updating, monitoring, and removing containers introduces challenges. This module explains some of those challenges and shows how Kubernetes can help.

programs.title: Create Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) with PWABuilder

It simplifies PWA development by automating the creation of essential components, providing a user-friendly interface for customization, and packaging PWAs for various platforms and app stores. Learn how to generate the app manifest, configure the service worker, and customize your PWA's settings and appearance to transform your project into a polished final product. Discover how to use PWABuilder to test PWAs on various devices and platforms, reserve app names, and successfully package a PWA for Microsoft Store submission.

learning_items.title: Introduction to PWABuilder

It simplifies PWA development by automating the creation of essential components, providing a user-friendly interface for customization, and packaging PWAs for various platforms and app stores. PWABuilder is an ideal choice for projects that require a seamless app-like experience across different devices and network conditions. By using PWABuilder, organizations can save time and resources while delivering users a seamless, app-like experience.

Customize settings and appearance, configure essential PWA features like push notifications and background sync, and transform your project into a polished, app-like experience for users.

learning_items.title: Test and publish Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) for Microsoft Store

Utilize PWABuilder to package and submit PWAs to the Microsoft Store, reserve app names, and navigate the Microsoft Partner Center for successful publication. Enhance PWA development skills and boost app performance and reach with this informative guide.

learning_items.title: Understand the purpose and evolution of datacenters
learning_items.description: In this module, you'll learn the basics of datacenters—what they are, why they exist, and their critical role in modern IT infrastructure. We'll explore the evolution of datacenters from mainframes to the cloud and look at different types, such as enterprise, colocation, cloud, and edge datacenters. You'll also discover the core components that make up a datacenter, including power supply, cooling, security. By the end, you'll have a clear understanding of the purpose and structure of datacenters.

learning_items.title: Learn about datacenter design, architecture, and infrastructure management
learning_items.description: In this module, we'll explore the key factors of datacenter design, delving into why they're crucial for building a reliable, scalable, and efficient infrastructure. You'll learn about site selection considerations such as power availability, climate, and risks from natural disasters. We'll also look at the layout of a datacenter, covering important elements like topologies, IT infrastructure, and space allocation. By the end of this module, you understand the importance of a well-architected datacenter.

learning_items.title: Identify key hardware and IT infrastructure components of datacenters
learning_items.description: In this module, we'll dive into the essential hardware and IT infrastructure that power datacenters. You'll learn about the different types of servers and their components, as well as various storage options like SAN, NAS, and object storage. We explore the network infrastructure inside a datacenter, including key components like switches, routers, and firewalls, along with how external connectivity is managed. Additionally, you discover the important IT apparatus such as racks and enclosures and application delivery controllers that help optimize performance and organization within the datacenter. By the end, you have a solid understanding of the hardware that supports the data storage, processing, and networking needs of a modern datacenter.

learning_items.title: Describe the best practices for datacenter operations
learning_items.description: In this module, we'll explore the essential operations that ensure the efficiency, reliability, and security of datacenters. Topics include the importance of monitoring key systems like environmental conditions, performance, and security, using tools like the DCIM (Datacenter Infrastructure Management). You'll learn how KPIs such as uptime and energy efficiency are tracked to optimize performance. We'll also cover maintenance practices for hardware, software, cooling systems, and power systems to prevent downtime. The end of the module will touch on regulations, reliability strategies, and disaster recovery.

learning_items.title: Describe the sustainability practices in datacenters
learning_items.description: Datacenters are the backbone of our connected world, powering everything from social media to critical business operations. Recognizing their significant role, the datacenter industry is embracing sustainability with a strong commitment to reducing its carbon footprint and enhancing energy efficiency. These efforts are paving the way for a greener, more sustainable future while continuing to support our digital lives. In this module, we focus on the importance of sustainability in datacenter operations. Topics include the use of renewable energy sources like solar and wind, and strategies for optimizing energy usage, and emergency power systems. We'll also explore advanced cooling techniques, including waste heat reuse, and water conservation practices. Additionally, you'll learn how KPIs help track sustainability progress and discover real-world case studies showcasing successful innovations in green datacenter design and operations.

learning_items.title: Learn about contributing to local economies through datacenters
learning_items.description: In this module, you'll explore the vital role datacenters play in shaping local economies and communities. More than just hubs of technology, datacenters serve as engines of opportunity, driving investment, innovation, and long-term prosperity. You'll learn how these digital infrastructure sites contribute to job creation, enhance local services, and foster economic growth. Additionally, this module examines how datacenters collaborate with local organizations through education, workforce training, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives. By the end of this module, you'll have a deeper understanding of the transformative impact datacenters have on the regions they serve.

learning_items.title: Plan, implement, and administer Conditional Access
learning_items.description: Conditional Access gives a fine granularity of control over which users and identities can do specific activities, access which resources, and how to ensure data and systems are safe—including AI agent identities managed through Microsoft Entra Agent ID.

learning_items.title: Manage Microsoft Entra Identity Protection
learning_items.description: Protecting a user's identity by monitoring their usage and sign-in patterns ensures a secure cloud solution. Explore how to design and implement Microsoft Entra Identity protection.

learning_items.title: Implement access management for Azure resources
learning_items.description: Explore how to use built-in Azure roles, managed identities, and RBAC-policy to control access to Azure resources. Identity is the key to secure solutions.

learning_items.title: Deploy and Configure Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
learning_items.description: The modern workforce transitioned from traditional office settings to working from nearly anywhere. This change in working location necessitates an identity-aware, cloud-delivered network perimeter. This identity-aware perimeter is known as Security Service Edge (SSE). The Microsoft SSE solution includes Microsoft Entra Internet Access and Microsoft Entra Private Access, collectively referred to as Global Secure Access. This solution is founded on Zero Trust principles, emphasizing least privilege, explicit verification, and an assumption of breach to ensure security in the cloud era.

programs.title: Implement security for Azure SQL databases
programs.description: Implement end-to-end security for Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance. Configure Entra ID authentication with managed identity access, deploy private endpoints, and apply encryption and access controls to protect sensitive financial data. Establish compliant audit trails and enable Microsoft Defender for Databases to detect SQL injection, anomalous access, and vulnerability exposures.

learning_items.title: Configure platform-level security for Azure SQL
learning_items.description: Configure authentication, network isolation, encryption, and access controls for Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance. Implement Microsoft Entra ID–only authentication with managed identity access for AI workloads, deploy private endpoints, and apply transparent data encryption, dynamic data masking, and row-level security to protect sensitive financial data.

learning_items.title: Configure auditing for Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance
learning_items.description: Configure audit logging for Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance to create tamper-resistant compliance records. Set audit action groups, route logs to Azure Monitor, Event Hubs, and immutable blob storage, and configure SQL Managed Instance–specific auditing to meet financial regulatory audit requirements.

learning_items.title: Implement Microsoft Defender for Databases
learning_items.description: Enable Microsoft Defender for Databases to detect SQL injection, anomalous query patterns, and vulnerability exposures across Azure SQL services. Enable protection at subscription scope using Azure Policy, configure vulnerability assessment baselines, and route security alerts to the security operations team.

programs.title: Implement security for Azure Storage for the cloud and AI security engineer
programs.description: Implement a defense-in-depth security strategy for Azure Storage. Harden storage accounts, govern access with Microsoft Entra ID and stored access policies, enforce network perimeter controls using firewall rules and private endpoints, and enable Microsoft Defender for Storage to detect threats from malicious uploads and compromised AI agent credentials.

learning_items.title: Describe Azure storage services

learning_items.title: Implement security and manage access for Azure Storage

learning_items.title: Configure network security for Azure Storage
learning_items.description: Configure network-layer access controls for Azure Storage accounts. Apply firewall rules, define virtual network and IP-based access, configure resource instance rules for Azure AI services, manage trusted service exceptions, and implement private endpoints to eliminate public endpoint exposure.

learning_items.title: Implement Microsoft Defender for Storage
learning_items.description: Enable and configure Microsoft Defender for Storage to detect threats against Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files, and Azure Data Lake Storage. programs.title: Configure and migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
programs.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL is a Platform as a Service database service in the Microsoft cloud. It bases itself on the PostgreSQL open-source relational database and includes built-in high availability, automatic backup and restore, as well as comprehensive security features. The pay-as-you-go pricing model provides predictable performance and near-instant scaling. In this learning path, you're introduced to the main features of PostgreSQL and how they work in Azure Database for PostgreSQL. You learn about the different Azure Database for PostgreSQL implementation options, and how to configure a server for your needs. (DP-3021)

learning_items.title: Explore PostgreSQL architecture
learning_items.description: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database system that is now available as a service in Azure. In this module, you learn about the PostgreSQL architecture, and how to manage different aspects of PostgreSQL in Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

learning_items.title: Understand client-server communication in PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: PostgreSQL is a client-server system, which allows many clients to connect to a central server. In this module you learn how PostgreSQL manages connections from clients, and looking at some common PostgreSQL client tools.

learning_items.title: Understand PostgreSQL query processing
learning_items.description: The Azure Database for PostgreSQL server receives SQL queries and returns the relevant results. Each SQL query goes through several stages in order to return the correct results as quickly as possible. In this module, you learn about the different stages of processing a query, and the EXPLAIN statement.

learning_items.title: Secure Azure Database for PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL includes comprehensive security features including encryption in transit and at rest, authentication, and granting permissions to database users. In this module you learn about the security features of Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and how to configure them.

learning_items.title: Procedures and functions in PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: PostgreSQL supports stored procedures and functions to make SQL queries reusable. In this module, you learn how to create and run stored procedures and functions.

learning_items.title: Understand write-ahead logging
learning_items.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL is an ACID compliant database service. Write-ahead logging ensures changes are both atomic and durable (the A and D in ACID). Changes are first written to the log before they're committed to the database. In this module, you learn how Azure Database for PostgreSQL implements write-ahead logging, and how the log can be used for replication and logical decoding.

learning_items.title: Configure and manage Azure Database for PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL efficiently manages vast quantities of data and their structures through system catalogs and views. This module explores how to optimize database performance by accessing and configuring metadata, understanding the role of the vacuum process in maintaining database health, and managing server settings. We introduce practical techniques to enhance your PostgreSQL database administration, useful in environments requiring robust data handling and security features.

learning_items.title: Understand concurrency in PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL is a multi-user relational database solution. The ability to support many concurrent users enables PostgreSQL databases to scale out and enable applications that support many users and locations at the same time. The increase in users brings a risk of conflicts. For this reason, it's important to understand the concurrency systems that are in place in Azure Database for PostgreSQL to manage concurrency and conflicts. In this module, we look at both isolation levels and locking in Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

learning_items.title: Tune queries in Azure Database for PostgreSQL
learning_items.description: Relational databases store many different types of data for many different types of applications. Some databases have thousands of users and some have just one user. Some tables have tens of rows while others have millions of rows. Some data is unique while other data is duplicated. All of these variables mean that database management systems (DBMSs) need systems to understand the data and the queries that are running against this data to ensure optimum performance. When you perform tune a database, it's important to understand how performance tuning works and how you can assess performance metrics.

learning_items.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server
learning_items.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server supports effective data migration from PostgreSQL servers. This module covers both online and offline migration methods and tools, helping you choose the right approach for your scenario. Learn practical techniques for managing migrations efficiently, ideal for minimizing downtime and maintaining productivity.
